Apache-2.0.name: Apache License 2.0 (the MASSP project's own licence; the distributor of the file states none)
Apache-2.0.attribution: MASSP subcortical parcellation, (c) Pierre-Louis Bazin, University of Amsterdam. The file used here is TemplateFlow's tpl-MNI152NLin2009cAsym_res-01_atlas-MASSP20_dseg.nii.gz, which arrives with no licence and no copyright notice of its own -- TemplateFlow publishes no sidecar for it. Apache License 2.0 is the licence the MASSP authors placed on the atlas priors the parcellation is produced from (doi:10.21942/uva.12074175), and it is recorded here as the best-evidenced upstream terms rather than as a statement by the distributor. The meshes derived from it are modified: the parcellation was read on the MNI152NLin2009cAsym grid, meshed by signed-distance field, smoothed, decimated and welded as the manifest records per mesh.

MNI-FreeSurfer.name: MNI/McGill template licence; the labels are a FreeSurfer segmentation for which no licence is stated

alignment_note: The HCP tractography is supplied in ICBM 2009a Nonlinear Asymmetric RAS millimetres. The prepared anatomy bundle reports MNI152NLin2009cAsym, with source-specific transformations retained in mesh metadata. This educational view overlays their standard stereotaxic coordinates without a new nonlinear 2009a-to-2009c registration. It must not be used for millimetre-level contact-to-tract distance measurement or patient localization.
